name: Patient-Specific Functional Scale
description: Patient identifies 3–5 activities they have difficulty with due to their condition and rates each 0–10. Average of activity scores reported.
shirleySays: ICC 0.84–0.97. MDC: 2 pts (per activity average). MCID: 2–3 pts. Patient selects own activities → captures personalized priorities. Validated across ALL body regions and diagnoses. Takes <5 min.

scoring.range: 0–10 per activity (avg of 3–5 activities; higher = better function)
scoring.mcidNote: 2–3 point change in average activity score is clinically meaningful
